note:
Setlist not definitively known. Download Series Volume 10 holds "nearly the entire concert" but omits the opener, Promised Land, and the soundboard gd72-07-21.sbd.cotsman.9246.sbeok.shnf does not carry it either — that tape opens with Sugaree. So the first song of the night is known to have been played and can be timed from nothing, which is why this is here rather than in data/partial-shows/: there is no blank for anyone to fill. The Jam between Drums and The Other One takes the tape's 3:45, the one song the release lacks that the tape does supply.

The truncated Weather Report Suite Prelude that the article says "follows Casey Jones" is deliberately absent. Per JerryBase it is "more of a tease, Bob bails on it and says with a chuckle 'Well anyway, what we're gonna do next is, uh history' and they go straight into Me And My Uncle" — 1:04 on the tape. Jason's call, 2026-08-14: no stripe. It is removed from this show only, not added to notASong, since the corpus carries real performances of the Prelude at 1973-11-30, 1974-10-17 and 1974-10-18.
